  • Your address bounces

    accountablecarpetclean.com forwards visitors to accountablecarpetclean.com/wp/?page_id=90, a raw WordPress address. That’s the link people see and share.

  • Google’s speed test couldn’t load it

    We ran Google PageSpeed Insights on your homepage and it timed out before measuring anything. If Google’s test can’t load the page, some customers can’t either.

  • Five headlines, none about you

    The page has five main headings: Reviews, Services, FAQ, Service Area and Photos. None says carpet cleaning in San Diego.

  • No email or online quote

    There’s no email address or form on the site, so the only way to reach you is a phone call during working hours.

  • No Google description

    The homepage has no summary for Google to show under your link.

  • 18 of 23 images Google can’t read

    Most of your photos have no description (alt text), so Google can’t tell they show your work.

Facebook / Instagram caption

Since 2009. 676 five-star Yelp reviews. One owner who answers the phone. ✅ Carpet · upholstery · tile & grout · flood water removal (619) 760-5238 #SanDiego #CarpetCleaning #ChulaVista #LaMesa

Website article

Truck-mounted vs. portable carpet cleaning: what’s the difference? 1. Heat. A truck-mounted unit heats water far hotter than a plug-in machine, and heat is what breaks down oils. 2. Suction. More suction pulls more water back out, so carpets dry faster. 3. Nothing inside your house but the hose. The noisy machine stays in the truck. 4. Ask your cleaner which they use. We’re truck-mounted on every job. Call Accountable at (619) 760-5238.
